# Claude / Anthropic — odoo19-syntax

This folder mirrors the canonical skill source. The pre-packaged `odoo19-syntax.skill` file in the parent directory is the upload-ready archive.

## Install (Claude.ai)

Settings → Capabilities → Skills → Upload skill → choose the `.skill` file.

## Install (Claude Code CLI)

Place this `odoo19-syntax/` folder under your project's `.claude/skills/` directory.
